name: doc-bridge
description: Deterministic repository handoffs for coding agents, running locally without an LLM or API key.
long_description: Doc Bridge turns a repository's own documentation and ownership metadata into deterministic handoffs: where an agent should start, which paths it may edit, which checks it must run, and when a human must take over. The local connector exposes the same read-only contract available through Doc Bridge CLI and CI.

tools.name: handoff.resolve
tools.description: Resolve a package or ownership id to its deterministic AgentHandoff.

tools.name: doc.search
tools.description: Search the deterministic Doc Bridge index for repository documentation.

tools.name: doc.get
tools.description: Read one indexed agent documentation file by id or indexed path.

tools.name: gate.status
tools.description: Evaluate documentation gates without writing files.

tools.name: retriever.query
tools.description: Return relevant local Doc Bridge index chunks for a query.

tools.name: memory.classify
tools.description: Classify local memory candidates into agent, human, playbook, or discard routes.

tools.name: memory.promoteDraft
tools.description: Build a reviewable draft promotion body from local memory candidates without publishing it.

tools.name: registry.topology
tools.description: Return the static Doc Bridge curator and delegate topology.

project_config.title: Doc Bridge configuration
